name: Turbo Rex

specialAbility.name: Tail Whip
specialAbility.description: Spins around and slams its massive dino tail into the enemy, dealing damage and knocking them backwards!

lore: What happens when you strap a turbo engine onto a truck shaped like a T-Rex? You get Turbo Rex — the meanest, greenest dinosaur on four wheels! It stomps into the arena roaring its engine, and when it whips that giant tail around, watch out! Even bigger trucks go flying!
